name: Crystal Atronach
location: Lucent Citadel, Fargrave Inner Quarter, Leftwheal Trading Post, Miscarcand, Mirrormoor Incursions, Broken Path Cave

abilities.name: Crystal Spear
abilities.description: Basic melee attack dealing low frost damage.

abilities.name: Crunch
abilities.description: Slightly stronger basic melee attack dealing low frost damage.

abilities.name: Glittering Scrape
abilities.description: The atronach stomps the ground and three glass tendrils emerge from the ground that swipe around, dealing minor physical damage and knocking back around them.

abilities.name: Pane Bound
abilities.description: The Crystal Atronach teleports nearby through a yellow portal.

notes: The Crystal Atronachs fought in the Catalyst Nook of the Lucent Citadel are much smaller, standing equal to average player height.
They are called Glass Atronachs in the files. This name was later reused for a polymorph.
Despite sharing a Frost Atronach model, killing Crystal Atronachs does not count towards the "Destroy 5 Frost Atronachs" endeavor.
They share the same model as Frost Atronachs (their mesh name is even called FrostAtronach_A_Basic) but with a different texture applied.
Prior to Update 42, Crystal Atronachs summoned by The Blind in Bedlam Veil were named Glass Remnant.

summary: Crystal Atronachs are crystalline Daedra that are composed of a reflective crystalline glass. They resemble Frost Atronachs in build.
